subject: Advance notice: Summer distance sampling workshop series

messages.subject: Advance notice: Summer distance sampling workshop series
parts:
Dear distance sampling folks,

If you're interested in receiving training in distance sampling methods,
here are some dates for your diary. All of the workshops will be given
in a live online videoconference format, with a mix of interactive
sessions and computer exercises. We'll post again when we're ready to
open registration.

- Spatially explicit models for distance sampling data: density surface
modelling in practice, 16th-20th August 2021.

- Distance sampling when animals are missed at zero distance, 30th-31st
August 2021.

- A practical guide to distance sampling survey design and simulation,
13th, 14th and 16th September 2021.

- Distance Live introductory online workshop, to be confirmed.

In addition, we hope to offer the following workshops later in the year:

- Camera trap distance sampling

- Further introductory workshops

With best wishes to all, Len
